FX-DIFFUSE-019.says: The two-layer diffusion as tomoex lays it: radius 10, lighten at 50, then soft light at 50. The shadow and the line lift as in lighten alone, then the soft light deepens the contrast a little: every dark channel (encoded below a half) of the glow pulls its pixel down, every light one lifts it.

FX-DIFFUSE-020.says: Screen at 50 then soft light at 50: the settings as they start (FX-DIFFUSE-001) with the second pass laid on.

FX-DIFFUSE-022.says: Screen at 50 with the second pass written at 0: exactly FX-DIFFUSE-001, sample for sample.

FX-DIFFUSE-023.says: Radius 3, amount 0, soft light at 100: only the second pass, the blurred picture in soft light over the drawing. Each channel moves toward the glow's side of an encoded half, darker where the glow is dark, lighter where it is light: the shadow's far corner (1, 1) darkens in every channel, and every skin pixel lightens in every channel.

FX-DIFFUSE-024.says: Radius 3, amount 0, overlay at 100: only the second pass, in overlay; the same directions as FX-DIFFUSE-023.

FX-DIFFUSE-025.says: Radius 0 with the second pass at 50: the drawing, untouched.

FX-DIFFUSE-026.says: Second amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, over lighten at 50: frame 0 is lighten alone, frame 2 is FX-DIFFUSE-019, frame 4 the soft light laid fully on.

FX-DIFFUSE-027.says: Second amount keyed from 0 to 100, eased past its end: held at 100 from frame 2, so frames 2 and 4 are FX-DIFFUSE-026's frame 4.

FX-DIFFUSE-028.says: FX-DIFFUSE-019 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-DIFFUSE-029.says: Second amount 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-030.says: Second amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-031.says: Second blend "screen", which is not soft_light or overlay. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-032.says: Second amount keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
